summary: Three hikers (a parent and two juveniles) stranded at ~11,000 ft in the Avalanche Creek area, unable to descend with limited food, water, and comms; CareFlight located and assisted evacuating them; rescuers met the helicopter at the Redstone Coke Ovens.
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen; CareFlight of the Rockies; Pitkin County Sheriff's Office
